mapper.select: SELECT e.etf_id, e.etf_code, e.etf_name, e.market, e.theme, e.fee, e.risk_rating, e.aum, e.current_price, e.return_1mo, e.return_3mo, e.return_6mo, e.return_1yr, e.return_3yr, e.description, e.created_at, e.like_count FROM likes l JOIN etf_product e ON l.etf_id = e.etf_id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e.aum DESC
